description: Calls a flaky remote operation again when it fails in a way worth retrying. The operation runs at most `attempts` times in total, whatever kind of retryable failure occurs: after a transient error the wait grows exponentially, after a rate-limit response the wait is what the server asked for (capped). When the last attempt fails, GaveUp is raised. Other exceptions pass straight through.

key.statement: A RateLimited failure is retried without being counted against `attempts`, so an operation that keeps being rate limited is retried forever.
